assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery is coded I25.10
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
The claim is for CPT code 93247
CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The CPT code 93247 claim is medically necessary to document and correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events
